name: crittersdeck
description: Report this machine's Claude Code sessions to a crittersdeck board, answer permission prompts and questions from the board, send each session's title and usage, and let sessions on different machines message each other.

ingest_url.title: Board ingest URL
ingest_url.description: The board's ingest address, e.g. https://crittersdeck-ingest.example.com (without /ingest).

token.title: Source token
token.description: The token the board showed when you added this source.

send_usage.title: Send titles and usage
send_usage.description: Send Claude's title for each session and its usage (context, tokens, cost, model; never prompt text). Reads this machine's Claude sign-in for sessions linked to claude.ai, and needs python3. Turn it off to send only session events.

agent_messages.title: Messages between agents
agent_messages.description: Let this machine's sessions send and receive messages through the board (deck_peers, deck_send, deck_inbox). Waiting messages are added to the next prompt, and a session that finishes with messages waiting carries on to read them. Turn it off to keep this machine out of it.
